author: Krono I
title: Dilated CNN Backbone for ConvLSTM Agent
abstract: This experiment explores a new direction after the failure of my gated MHA (ID 117). Instead of modifying the attention mechanism, this work focuses on enhancing the CNN backbone of the SOTA ConvLSTM agent. I have replaced the standard convolutions in the residual blocks with dilated convolutions (dilation rate=2). The hypothesis is that increasing the receptive field of the feature extractor will allow the agent to learn long-range spatial dependencies more effectively, providing a richer input to the ConvLSTM and improving overall planning performance.
